active_filter_rule: For each minor_gases_{lower,upper} identifier, find it in identifier_minor, map its index through gas_minor to an absorber gas name, and retain iff that mapped gas is in available_gases. Source: mo_gas_optics_rrtmgp.F90:2021-2033 and :1808-1827.

loader_dimension_contract.note: Respect NetCDF named dimensions and the Fortran read_field argument order; do not treat compact contributor positions as g-point IDs. The g-point interval and coefficient start jointly select a table segment.

offset_rule: In source order, each removed interval contributes (minor_limits_gpt(2,i)-minor_limits_gpt(1,i)+1) to n_elim. For a retained interval, reduced kminor_start = original kminor_start - n_elim from preceding removed intervals. See mo_gas_optics_rrtmgp.F90:2066-2086.
scope: Static coefficient/loader metadata reconstruction only. No gas column amounts, pfrac, k interpolation, optical-depth, or radiation values computed.
